meta.description:
This interactive map shows field boundaries across all major European Countries generated using the **Delineate Anything v2** algorithm applied to the 2025 summer season Sentinel-2 Global Mosaics (S2GM), with the WorldCereal 2021 map used as a delineation mask.

 To view the field boundaries, zoom in to a local in a country of your choice. The boundaries are displayed on the map when the scalebar in the bottom left displays 5 km or less.

**Please note** that the field boundaries are overlaid on high-resolution satellite imagery from the Stadia Maps service. As a result, some misalignment may be visible, since the boundaries were derived from Sentinel-2 data.

### Further information
Details of methodology are available on the [Delineate Anything Project Page](https://lavreniuk.github.io/Delineate-Anything/)

### Authors
[Mykola Lavreniuk](https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=-oFR-RYAAAAJ) (1,2), [Nataliia Kussul](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=e3TWBuwAAAAJ&hl=en) (3), [Andrii Shelestov](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=tqoQKZAAAAAJ&hl=en) (2,4), [Bohdan Yailymov](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=XaN-oukAAAAJ&hl=en) (2), [Yevhenii Salii](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=4jgAsBIAAAAJ&hl=en) (2,4), [Volodymyr Kuzin](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Volodymyr-Kuzin) (2,4), [Zoltan Szantoi](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=P_pyhi8AAAAJ&hl=en) (1)

[1] European Space Agency, [2] SRI NASU-SSAU, [3] University of Maryland, [4] Igor Sikorsky Kyiv Polytechnic Institute

The high-voltage transmission grid is the backbone that moves power from generation to demand and connects countries, so it shapes where new energy projects can connect. European transmission lines (220 to 750 kV AC and all HVDC), coloured by voltage.
